subject: English
passage: Several museums ______ the art collection of the downtown cultural district, including the Modern Art Gallery and the Contemporary Sculpture Center.
prompt: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanation:
Choice A is the best answer. The convention being tested is the use of verb forms within a sentence. A main clause requires a finite (tensed) verb to perform the action of the subject (in this case, "several museums"), and this choice supplies the finite present tense verb "house" to indicate that there are several museums housing the art collection of the downtown cultural district.

Why C is incorrect:

Choice C is incorrect because it results in an ungrammatical sentence. The nonfinite to-infinitive "to house" doesn't supply the main clause with a finite verb.
